bio.text: Guy Reschenthaler represents Pennsylvania's 14th Congressional District in the U.S. House, where he serves as House Chief Deputy Whip and sits on the Appropriations Committee.
He graduated from Penn State Behrend and Duquesne University law school, then served in the U.S. Navy Judge Advocate General Corps, including in Iraq.
He was elected a magisterial district judge in 2013 and to the Pennsylvania State Senate in 2015.
